case_name: Ramdas v State Of Madhya Pradesh
respondent:
State Of Madhya Pradesh
Supreme Court of India

13 January 2009
CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 47 OF 2009
[Arising 0ut of S.L.P. (Crl.) No.7738 OF 2008]
The Judgment was delivered by : Lokeshwar Singh Panta, J.
Delay condoned.
Special leave granted.
1.  This appeal arises out of judgment dated 26.10.2007 passed by the High Court of Madhya Pradesh, Bench at Gwalior, whereby and whereunder the appeal preferred by the appellant has been partly allowed. By the impugned judgment, the learned Single Judge of the High Court altered the conviction of the appellant from Section 307 of the Indian 2 Penal Code (for short ' IPC') to Section 324  IPC recorded by the learned Sessions Judge, Morena, in Sessions Trial No. 190/1999 and sentenced him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 3 years instead of 7 years as imposed by the trial judge. Fine of Rs.2,000/-, out of which a sum of Rs.1,500/- was ordered to be paid to Smt. Shakuntla Bai (PW-4) widow of deceased Krishna Sharma, has not been interfered wi
facts: The incident leading to the prosecution of the appellant occurred on 20.08.1994 at Village Purawas Khurd, Police Station Sihoniy, District Morena, Madhya Pradesh.
According to the prosecution, one month prior to the day of the incident, Shri Krishna Sharma purchased a she-buffalo from appellant Ramdas for a consideration of Rs.5,000/-.
On 19.08.1994, calf of she-buffalo was born.
On the day of incident, i.e. 20.08.1994, at about 10 a.m. Shri Krishna Sharma went to the house of the appellant for the payment of Rs.5,000/- where Sheetal Prasad co-accused was also present.
The appellant made a demand of Rs.150/- towards interest amount for which Shri Krishna Sharma did not agree because there was no such agreement between the parties to pay the interest of Rs.150/-.
On this trivial issue, some altercation took place between the parties, as a result whereof the appellant dealt sickle blow on the back of the person of Shri Krishna Sharma.
issues: Whether the conviction of the appellant under Section 307 IPC was proper?
petitioner_arguments: The appellant has already undergone about 15 months of imprisonment in terms of the order of the High Court.
Justice would be sub-served if the sentence imposed by the High Court, is reduced to the sentence already undergone by the appellant.
court_reasoning: On our close scrutiny of the testimony of eye-witnesses - PWs 2 and 3 and having gone through the First Information Report (Ex.P/1), it is clear that on the date of the incident, all of a sudden altercation ensued between the appellant and deceased Shri Krishna Sharma on the issue of payment of Rs.150/- as interest amount.
There is no evidence on record to indicate that there was any previous enmity between the appellant and the deceased.
The opinion of the doctor proves that the deceased had not died due to direct result of injury no. 10 sustained by him.
holding: While maintaining the conviction of the appellant under Section 324 IPC, the sentence of 3 years imposed by the learned Single Judge of the High Court is reduced to imprisonment already suffered by the appellant.
Ramdas-appellant, who is in custody, is directed to be set at liberty and released forthwith unless wanted in connection with any other case.
